# simplemdm_app_installs (Data Source)

Lists every installation record (per device) of a managed application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_app_installs" "example" {
  app_id = "1234"
}

output "managed_devices" {
  value = [
    for install in data.simplemdm_app_installs.example.installs :
    install.device_id if install.managed
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Required. ID of the application whose install records to list.

### Read-Only

- `installs` (Block List) Collection of install records for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--installs))

<a id="nestedblock--installs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `installs`

Read-Only:

- `bundle_size` (Number) Bundle size in bytes.
- `device_id` (String) ID of the device the application is installed on.
- `discovered_at` (String) Timestamp when the install was first discovered.
- `dynamic_size` (Number) Dynamic size in bytes.
- `id` (String) Installed app record ID.
- `identifier` (String) Application bundle identifier.
- `last_seen_at` (String) Timestamp when the install was last reported.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the install is managed by SimpleMDM.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `short_version` (String) Application short version string.
- `version` (String) Application version.
